note: Wikimedia Commons, “St Andrew the Apostle - Bulgarian icon.jpg”; artist as recorded there: MrPanyGoff — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it as 'An icon of St. Andrew the Apostle by the Bulgarian iconographer Yoan from Gabrovo. 19th century', in Category:Icons of Saint Andrew. The Apostle Andrew is the First-Called; no other apostle bears the name. Commons describes it: An icon of St. Andrew the Apostle by the Bulgarian iconographer Yoan from Gabrovo. 19th century. Exhibited at Hadzhi Nikoli Inn museum, Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria.
